meta.name: push-to-forked-pr
meta.description: Push the current working tree directly to a GitHub PR whose head lives on a **fork**, without creating a new branch and without pushing to `origin` (which is usually the upstream). Invoke when the user says things like "push straight to PR

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 直接推送本地改动到已有的拉取请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要往已有的拉取请求补提交,又不想多建分支。
copy.tagline_en: Push local changes directly to an existing pull request without creating a new branch.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to push straight to an existing PR from a fork without creating extra branches.

howto.what: 它会直接把当前工作区的改动推送到指定 PR 所在的分支(常在别人的 fork 里),不新建分支、不推给上游。推送前会检查权限、运行测试、确认提交身份。
howto.when: 当你说“直接推到 PR #N”“推到 fork 的 PR”“更新来自 fork 的 PR”等,尤其强调不要新建分支或不要推送到上游时触发。

say.text: 把当前改动直接推到 PR #12
更新那个来自 fork 的 PR,别新建分支
say.note: 按 PR 头部分支推送,不改动 origin。

say.text: 提交并推送到 PR #8,不要动 origin
say.note: 先跑测试再推送到 fork 分支。

howto.what_en: Pushes your working tree directly to the branch behind a GitHub PR, even when that branch lives in a fork. Checks permissions, verifies author identity, runs tests/builds, then pushes to the fork—never creating a new branch or pushing to origin.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say things like "push straight to PR #N", "push to the forked PR", "update PR from fork", especially when you stress not creating a new branch or not pushing to upstream.

say_en.text: Push these changes directly to PR #12
say_en.note: Claude checks permission and pushes to the PR's fork branch.

say_en.text: Update that forked PR, don't create a new branch
say_en.note: Pushes to the PR head branch, leaving origin untouched.

say_en.text: Commit and push to PR #8, don't touch origin
say_en.note: Runs tests first, then pushes to the fork branch.
